summary: Iteration 22: Full testing of new features — Sector Momentum Dashboard and Multi-horizon Price Bands. All 36 backend tests pass. All frontend UI tests pass. Both features are fully functional and correctly integrated.

key_findings.sector_momentum_api: GET /api/sector-momentum returns all 15 sectors with momentum_score, direction, return_1w/1m/3m, rsi, adx. Summary has bullish_sectors, bearish_sectors, neutral_sectors, market_breadth, avg_momentum_score.
key_findings.sector_momentum_caching: In-memory + MongoDB dual-layer caching. Second call returns from_cache=True. force_refresh=true bypasses both caches and returns from_cache=False.
key_findings.sector_cards_testids: All 15 sector card testids confirmed: sector-card-metal, sector-card-power, sector-card-it, sector-card-capital-goods, sector-card-defence, sector-card-telecom, sector-card-banking, sector-card-consumer-durables, sector-card-fmcg, sector-card-oil---gas, sector-card-pharma, sector-card-cement, sector-card-auto, sector-card-realty, sector-card-insurance
key_findings.vol_bands_infy: INFY vol_bands has all 6 horizons (1W,1M,3M,6M,9M,1Y). Each band has: upside_pct, downside_pct, conservative_high_pct, optimistic_high_pct, hist_vol_pct, flag. All flags are GREEN for INFY. hist_vol_pct=27.0%.
key_findings.multibagger_bands_toggle: 45 toggle buttons in main Multibagger table (for stocks with vol_bands). Toggle shows 'Show Price Bands' → 'Hide Price Bands' on click. Expands to show table with all 6 horizons: Conservative, Expected Upside, Expected Downside, Optimistic, HV%, Signal.
key_findings.custom_search_price_bands: Custom search result (INFY) shows price bands inline (no toggle button - always visible below thesis row).
key_findings.frontend_nav: nav-sectors button (data-testid=nav-sectors) visible in nav bar. home-module-sectors card (data-testid=home-module-sectors) visible on home dashboard.

critical_code_review_comments: NOTE: sector-card testid for 'Oil & Gas' produces slug 'oil---gas' (triple dash from '& ' → '--' mapping via regex /[^a-z]/g). Not a bug but worth noting if UI filtering by slug is needed.
NOTE: Backend file /app/backend/server.py is 6715 lines — very large file that should ideally be split into routers per domain, but this is not a breaking issue.
VERIFIED: Sector momentum has dual-layer caching (in-memory dict + MongoDB) with 30-minute TTL — works correctly.
seed_data_creation: None - used cached sector momentum data from previous test runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22: Both new features fully working.
